name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.28.1: corrects the payment port rule, which v6.28 got wrong, and fixes the default that leaves a restarted single-door fridge unable to take cards. The rule is not coil-versus-gravity, it is three-way and confirmed on real hardware: coil reads Nayax on ttyS3 (ttyS1 is motors), a DOUBLE fridge on ttyS1, and a SINGLE fridge on ttyS4, with ttyS3 the weight bus on both fridge sizes. The two sizes do not match each other and neither follows from the other. The three days lost on 8626020716 were on a double, where ttyS4 is dead; v6.28 generalised that to all gravity machines and so would have refused the CORRECT port on a single and recommended a dead one - the same class of mistake in the opposite direction. fridgePlanogramBlock now defaults single-door fridges to ttyS4 rather than ttyS1, which is what makes the port survive a restart: the port is only carried in config when the model is GR-*, so on a machine still registered as coil a port set by command lives in app state and is lost on restart, and the machine comes back on a default that takes no cards and says nothing. Port size is derived from the model, so when the model does not identify a fridge the size is genuinely unknown and the guard now allows any plausible port rather than refusing and blocking the only person who can fix it. Cumulative over v6.28.
